parameters.name: sort

schema.description: Which order to answer in: RECENT_UPDATE (journeys.updated_at, newest first), DEPARTURE_DATE (journeys.start_at, earliest first) or TITLE (journeys.title, case-folded).  Any other word is refused by name.  No `sort` keeps the order this door has always answered in - journeys.created_at, then journeys.id.
